text: Antonius Nuncius is an Imperial priest who may be found at Fort Frostmoth on the island of Solstheim.

Aphia Velothi is the Dunmer wife of Crescius Caerellius living in Raven Rock. She is initially found inside Raven Rock Mine while arguing with her husband. She disapproves of his venturing into the mine, because she thinks he is getting too old. She is an Adept-level Restoration trainer and is willing to teach the Dragonborn the skill.
Anrel is a Bosmer warrior and member of House Hlaalu. She can be found in Llethan Manor at the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. She works for the widow of King Athyn Llethan, Ravani Llethan.

Antoine Dubois was the owner of Dubois and Sons Carpentry. He was a Breton carpenter native to High Rock. His work was well renowned across Tamriel, where he has done repairs and other jobs in the many provinces.
Arbene Gernis is a Breton healer, and a member of House Telvanni residing in Shishara. If Shishara is entered by people not connected to House Telvanni, Arbene will attack on sight.
Arbhu-ra is a Khajiit and one of the joint leaders of the Duneraider Bandits, a group of brigands encountered within the Lost City of the Na-Totambu.
Apothecary Muriel is a deceased Breton ghost residing in the village of Westtry, High Rock.
Areneth Food-Finder is a Bosmer grocer who resides in The Improbable Cutlet Inn within the town of Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Arantale is an Altmer residing in the city of Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Aranecarne is an Altmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Antys Bienena is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle in Stormhaven. She and her husband Kasorayn Bienena are found inside their home, next to the Mages Guild.
Anya Branck is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is the clothier at The High King's Forge, where she sells her wares.
Arathel is a Bosmer who resides in Davon's Watch in Stonefalls. She can usually be found on the docks.
Anyon is an Altmer residing at the Mages Guildhall in the city of Arenthia, Reaper's March.
Aranorne is an Altmer carpenter residing in the city of Dune, Reaper's March.
Aranias is an Altmer in Bramblebreach, Greenshade. When spoken to she mentions a book she wrote titled Spriggans in the Green: Story and Myth in Primitive Bosmer Society.
Antonin Lielleve is a Breton magus and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Belkarth.

Ansei Halelah is a Redguard ghost residing in the Motalion Necropolis, in the Alik'r Desert region. She is one of the three Ansei warriors who gave up their lives to create the Ansei Wards, alongside Ansei Radan and Ansei Maja.
Anylos Indavel is a Dunmer beggar found in the city of Ebonheart.
Anooz-Izt is an Argonian found at the Registrar Office in Shad Astula. He has no unique dialogue.
Anozz-Crath is an Argonian brewer and the owner of Riverbrew, located in Hissmir, Shadowfen.
Ansei Radan is a Redguard ghost found in Tu'whacca's Throne.
Antonia Gratas is an Imperial soldier of the Imperial Legion found at the Sixth Legion Surplus stall, Antonia's camp, near the Mountain Overlook Wayshrine.
Anurlan is an Altmer residing in the town of in S'ren-ja, Reaper's March.
Appraising-Spine is a dead Argonian whose corpse can be found in the Obsidian Gorge.
Apprentice Ithrini is a Dunmer merchant found near the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Apprentice Odrethin is a Bosmer apprentice with the Fighters Guild found outside the Vulkhel Guard guildhall, watching over a senior member's dog.
Aradhel is a Bosmer patron of the Frozen Palms Tavern in Sentinel. She has no unique dialogue.
Aranak is a Khajiit merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, Aranak's Amenities, in the small town Karthdar in the region of Grahtwood, Valenwood.
Arani Longhair is a Nord bard residing in Windhelm, Eastmarch. She works at The Sober Nord Tavern. She has no unique dialogue.
Arara Salvani is a Dunmer residing in the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch.

Ansei Kalam was known as master of polearms. He had a daughter named Ra Adia. Ansei Kalam and his daughter drove out the bandits that had harassed their people for two decades. When the Vestige went to The Valley of Blades ancestral crypt in Hammefell to find the Amulet of Kings, Mannimarco raised Ansei Kalam's skeleton to stop the Vestige.
Anvil Guards are generic guards who patrol the city of Anvil, Gold Coast. They have no unique dialogue.
Arbhuz is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He is found at the Bangkorai Garrison after it is back in Daggerfall Covenant control.
Anther is a Nix-Hound that appears in . They are a peaceful creature found in Selfora Inn, amongst the other survivors of Vox's attack on the town.
Anya Lateur is a Breton found in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Artiber of Perfection is a Dwarven centurion found at the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Antomine is an Altmer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Apprentice Fasarel is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild. He and his team can be located within Fungal Grotto.
Arantar is an Aldmeri Dominion soldier. He resides in a camp outside of Rawl'kha, Reaper's March.
Aojee-Ei is an Argonian. He is one of the potential assassination targets assigned by Speaker Terenus.
Apprentice Scale-Mender is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild. She is part of the expedition led by Warlock Carindon taking place in Selene's Web.
Anton Dufont is a Breton working as a servant at the Pellingare Manor in Wayrest.
Apprentice Patraud is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is part of the expedition led by Warlock Carindon into Selene's Web.
Arbella is a Breton in who is a member of the Daggerfall Covenant posted at Fort Dragonclaw.
Arayni Varo is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.
Antus Glaucia is an Imperial found at a shrine of Akatosh located in the Gold Coast. Like his wife, he will disappear after the completion of Pious Intervention.
Aquila Drusus is an Imperial patron of The Slaking Chalice in Kozanset.
Anral Selvilo is a Dunmer banker working at Lord Vivec's Vault in Foundation's Rising in Vivec City.
Aojee-Mota is an Argonian residing in Tel Mora, on Vvardenfell.

Arakaul "the Unbroken" was an Orsimer who served with Baloth Bloodtusk during the Siege of Orsinium. In , he is not interacted with, but when you drink from the water in Honor's Rest, you are transported in his body to a memory of his.

The Arbordawn Archer is a member of the Arbordawn Cult that appears in Reaper's March, in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be worn to avoid them.
Anodia Oclatinus is an Imperial clothier working at a loom in the Tailors and Dyers Hall within the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.

The Arbordawn Quickblade is a member of the Arbordawn Cult that appears in Reaper's March, in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be worn to avoid them.
Apprentice Chirrhari is a Khajiit member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Everwound Wellspring in the Clockwork City.
Apprentice Idrono is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Everwound Wellspring, Clockwork City.
Apprentice Ohtowen is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Everwound Wellspring, Clockwork City.
Araitha is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild found in the guildhall in Shimmerene, Summerset, where she can be seen sweeping the upper floor. She has no unique dialogue.
Anwulsawen is an Altmer residing in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Aphaurin Spenard is a Breton newcomer to Summerset held in a cage within the Undercroft Passage of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. He has no unique dialogue.
Arartar is an Altmer who can be found on the northwestern coast of Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.
Arbert Canis is a Breton who can be found in the Academy Guest Wing in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.

Aranande is an Altmer Thalmor Justiciar who appears in . She is protected by two Thalmor Soldiers. She will appear in the town once the quest "Secrets of the Ayleids" has been completed. She wears Thalmor robes and carries an Ebony Longsword.
Arawende is an Altmer residing in the Lilmoth Guild Hall of Murkmire in Black Marsh. She can be found studying books in the main room of the Guild Hall.
Anton Deleyn II was a former king of Daggerfall. He was preceded by Queen Donella.
Arana is a Reachmen leader of the witch-rebels. She has a sister named Nathari.

Apprentice Taz is a Redguard residing outside Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr, in . He is an apprentice in the Elsweyr Defense Force and second-in-command to Captain Samara who leads a training program for Dragon-slaying. Taz wields a two handed greatsword with medium armor without a helmet in the Dragonguard Style.
Antonius is a character in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Orcish Scaled Creation Club content.

Arkay, or Ark'ay, sometimes referred to as the Bringer of Light, and also known as the God of the Cycle of Birth and Death, is a major divinity of the Nine Divines, the official religion of the Cyrodilic Empires, and represents the qualities of birth and death, most particularly burials and funeral rites, as well as on occasion being linked to the cyclical nature of the seasons. Some sources state that Arkay's life began as a mortal, who joined the ranks of the gods.
Ariela Doran is an Imperial commoner residing in the town of Chorrol with her husband, Jirolin. Both Ariela and her husband spend all of their time inside their home, keeping to themselves.

Arkan was a male Breton. He was the Scribe of Daggerfall during the rule of King Gothryd's predecessors. Arkan was the author of The First Scroll of Baan Dar, which he wrote in 2E 24. The Scroll of Baan Dar was a collective work attempting to describe and explain the mysterious bandit god, Baan Dar. es:Arkan

Arlimahera was a Redguard Blood Queen of Hegathe. In Arlimahera's diaries, which were written in 2E 412, she provides the earliest known record that mentions the Dark Brotherhood. She is also mentioned in The Worthy Ar-Azal, His Deeds, as a daughter of Crown Ruler Murahd of Rihad.

Arielle Phiencel is a Breton Nightblade who resides at the Sadrith MoraMages Guild in Wolverine Hall. She is an apprentice-ranked member of the guild, and is responsible for negotiating contracts to hire local members. She also offers a number of spells for purchase.
Aredhel is a Bosmer enforcer residing in Tel Branora. She is a member of House Telvanni, and has no unique dialogue.
Arius Rulician is an Imperial living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is a member of the Imperial Legion and the Talos Cult. He resides in the basement of the Gnisis Barracks beside a Talos shrine.
Arielle Jurard is a Breton battlemage who is a member of the Mages Guild who, alongside Roliand Hanus, is investigating Caminalda on the Gold Road.
Ardaline is an Altmer and a Mages Guild member who resides in the Bravil Mages Guild. She is also a Journeyman of Alchemy ingredients.
Areldur is an Altmer crusader and priest in the Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol.

Ariulcabor Leontiulonus is an Imperial assassin, and smuggler who resides in the cave of Ashir-Dan, near Khuul. Like the other smugglers in Ashir-Dan, he is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
Arkming the Flayer is a Nord Barbarian, and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Argis the Bulwark is a Nord housecarl who can be found in Vlindrel Hall in Markarth.
Arcadia is an Imperial apothecary and an expert alchemist who runs Arcadia's Cauldron in Whiterun.
Aringoth is an Altmer and is the owner of Goldenglow Estate, the primary supplier of honey for Black-Briar Meadery. He is involved in the Thieves Guild quest "Loud and Clear."
Arivanya is an Altmer resident of Windhelm and wife of Ulundil. She is one of the possible women to be murdered by The Butcher at the end of "Blood on the Ice."
Ardwen is a traveling Bosmer priestess. She can be encountered after the Gildergreen is restored.
Ari was a Nord bandit in Falkreath Hold. Her corpse lies in Moss Mother Cavern, after she was killed by a spriggan.
Arelvam Sadrano is a Dunmer bandit residing in Sanabi. Arelvam is hostile towards the Nerevarine, and will attack them on sight.
Aren Maren is a Dunmer Gondolier who resides in Morrowind. He owns and operates gondola in the canals, near the Hlaalu Canton in Vivec City.

Arethan Mandas is a Dunmer who resides in Milk. Arethan was once a member of House Redoran, but has since lost not only his title, but his mind. He went insane as the news of his daughter, Delyna Mandas being kidnapped.
Areldil is an Altmer residing in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. He does not not give any valuable information or start any quests and is mostly just a background character.
Arena Mouth is an Imperial, and serves as announcer for all matches in the Arena. Despite having a physical body, he is not seen in the game without console commands.
Ariente was an Altmer who was sent to the Forsaken Mine along with Viranus Donton and fellow Fighters Guild members to clear it from trolls, but was unable to successfully do so.

Ardhil is a Bosmer Witch in who can be found in the "Upper Level" of the Dunmer Stronghold Falensarano. Unlike the other witches found in Falensarano, Ardhil will not attack the Nerevarine on sight, but will defend herself if attacked.

Arch-Curate Vyrthur is one of the last living Snow Elves, alongside his brother Knight-Paladin Gelebor, and is the secondary antagonist of the storyline. He is also a vampire, and believes that Auri-El is to blame for allowing him to turn after becoming infected.
Arctus is a Nord high priest of Dementia. He resides in the church Sacellum Arden-Sul in New Sheoth.
Ardarume is an Altmer Mage and Mysticism master trainer. She resides in the west wing of the Gateway Inn, on the western side of Sadrith Mora.
Arcorion is an Altmer enchanter residing in the region of Auridon located in the Summerset Isles.
Arcineaux is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She is leaning against a wall, flipping a coin.
Arch-Mage Shalidor is the Arch-Mage for the Mages Guild appearing in all three factions during the Mages Guild quest line.
Ariashurr is a Khajiit beggar found inside The Middens of Elden Root.
Ardorin is an Altmer armsman residing in the Marbruk Fighters Guild in Greenshade, Valenwood.
Arfolasse is an Altmer laborer who resides in the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon.
Archimbert Dantaine is an old scholar found near the Wormroot Depths.
Arcady Charnis is a Breton residing in Dreughside outside Wayrest in Stormhaven. He has been dragged away by Dreugh and his wife is afraid he might not still be alive.

Argi Farseer is an unused Nord character who would have lived in a hut in Stonehills, were she to have made the final edition of the game. She would have been the sister of Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone of Hjaalmarch.
Arfedar is a Redguard residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.
Arianna Stende is a Breton residing in the city of Evermore.
Arcorion Two-Blades is an assassin working on the behalf of House Montclair found in his camp west of Shornhelm.
Arela is a Dunmer woodworker. She sells her wares at her stall, Arela's Assault Tools, in Shor's Stone.
Arendil Indrano is a traveling Dunmer merchant. He is found on the road south of the Starved Plain.
Arenion is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in the guildhall in Vulkwasten.
Areshu is a Redguard weaponsmith. She is the owner of A Panoply of Blades and is also a member of the Mages Guild found on Eyevea.
Arethil is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camp in Vivec's Antlers.
Aretino Buca is an Imperial alchemist. He sells his wares at his store, The Adept's Retreat, in Windhelm.
Ariane is the leader of the bandits occupying Portdun Watch.
Aribert Plourde is a Breton noble participating in the festivities at the At-Tura Estate.
Arilen Maralvel is a Dunmer whose corpse can be found in the mortuary of Stormhold.
Arith-Enle is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Arkas is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at the Warrior's Rest Tavern at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Arlie Edrald is a Breton in . She is the daughter of Allan Edrald and Krisandra Edrald, and betrothed of Federic Seychelle. She lives in Edrald Estate along with her parents.
Archmage Camaano is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance found in the ruins of Naril Nagaia.
Arganar is a Bosmer of the Driladan Clan found in the Shadows Crawl.
Archivist Sanctius is an Imperial scholar part of the Seventh Legion forces found in Razak's Wheel.
Archivist Poneria is an Imperial scholar part of the Seventh Legion forces found in Razak's Wheel.
Ariana at-Fara is a Redguard warrior member of the Greycloak Mercenaries found inside Haddock's Market.
Arena Champion Ladra is a Redguard and one half of the champions of the arena at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Arena Champion Adit is a Redguard and one half of the champions of the arena at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Argonian Reveler is an Argonian residing in Sanguine's Demesne, in the region of Shadowfen.
Argonian Behemoths are creatures in . They apparently like to eat Naga. At least some are created by the Hist.
Arlettie Tardif is a Breton merchant residing in her shop at the garrison in the region of Bangkorai.
Argablog is an ogre that appears in . They are one of two creatures required to be killed at this location in order to get the achievement for clearing it.
Arcimil is an Altmer clothier located in Morkuldin Haven, near its northern entrance.
Ardalure is an Altmer mystic. She sells her wares at her store, The Sorcerer's Safeguard, in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Arielle Jegnole is a Breton woodworker found offering her services in The Carved Bough in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Arengo the Shadow is a Bosmer member of the Shadow Walkers clan found at The Moonless Walk.
Archimbide is a Breton member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Areyne Faryon is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares at The Reaver Citadel once it is clear of Daedra.
Arek is a Nord New Life Festival celebrant who may be found south of Windhelm, in Eastmarch.

Archcanon Tarvus Indoril, more commonly referred to as simply Archcanon Tarvus, was a Dunmer male who served as archcanon of the Tribunal Temple during the Interregnum in the Second Era. Growing up as a member of House Indoril, Tarvus was drawn to the words of Lord Vivec the Warrior-Poet—one of three divine rulers of Morrowind—and joined the Tribunal Temple in order to serve him. While training as an acolyte, he sought to eventually become a Buoyant Armiger, but Vivec persuaded him to pursue the life in the priesthood instead. The diligence and dedication he displayed in his service to the Tribunal convinced Vivec to select Tarvus as his new archcanon, the youngest in history at the time of
Arith Sendrul is a Dunmer House Telvanni member residing in Tel Aruhn, in Vvardenfell. He can also be found in Sadrith Mora, in Sun-in-Shadow's House.
Crown Princess Ariella Septim is a retconned character from . She is only mentioned in the story introduction of Arenas French manual, and does not appear again in .

The Arbordawn Wildling is a member of the Arbordawn Cult that appears in Reaper's March, in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be worn to avoid them.
Arethil Wethrin is a character in . According to Princess Barynia, Arenthil and his partner kidnapped her to blackmail King Barynia.
Arillas is an Altmer residing in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset, in . He is the leader of a group of cavern dwellers.
Archivist Murboga is an Orsimer archivist of Fharun Clan, located at the entrance to Fharun Stronghold. She is not in good shape when first met, and so will die.

Argar is an Argonian that used to be working as an assistant under Urzashi. He can be found dead inside a delve on one of the three Alliances' zones, Stonefalls, Glenumbra or Auridon. He was supposed to pick up a package for Urzashi, but he was killed when he entered the old ruin.
Ard Caddach is a Reachmen Ard of Markarth. He can be found in Understone Keep with his advisor Lady Belain.
Arelvam Llenim is a Dunmer outlaw laying low at the Lilmoth Outlaws Refuge in Lilmoth.

Archivist Thalas is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . He can be found near the bookshelves under the staircase, in front of Molag Bal's statue. He has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Arch-Magister Delric is a Breton residing in Lady Arabelle's Camp in Vvardenfell.

Arlowe Viducia is an Imperial located at the Sentinel Bazaar in Sentinel, Alik'r Desert, in . He sells and traps lizards by trade and only appears during the quest "A Taste for Toxins." He wears a green and maroon pirate sash and bandolier garb.
Arquen is an Altmer assassin and Speaker of the Black Hand who leads the Cyrodiilic Dark Brotherhood in .

Arrille is an Altmer Trader who resides in Seyda Neen. He is the sole merchant in town and owns Arrille's Tradehouse. If his friend's ring is returned to its owner, Arrille offers a special discount on his wares and spells.
Aryni Orethi is a Dunmer commoner. She lived in Ald'ruhn for a time, until she was convinced to move to Indarys Manor and marry a man there by House Redoran agents. Aryni carries a key to her chest.
Arslan II was a Breton king of Daggerfall. He was the father of Lysandus of Daggerfall, and was married to Nulfaga. He was the King of Daggerfall before Lysandus.

Arthago was a disgraced Prince of Sentinel during the late Third Era, being the firstborn of King Camaron and Queen Akorithi. Arthago was born feeble and weak, much to the dismay of his parents. Despite this, Arthago had went on the path of a scholar and showed much appreciation for history.
Asciene Rane is a Breton mage that arrived with Apelles Matius in Ebonheart. A friend of Apelles Matius, she helps the Nerevarine travel to Mournhold.
Ash Vampires, also known as Heartwights, are a type of enemy in .
Arns Saren is a Dunmer Noble residing in her home in the Vivec Redoran Canton. She is a member of House Redoran.

Arthcamu is a fictional character that appears in the book The Locked Room. He is the master of a lockpicking school and the cruel teacher of Yana. He is later killed when Yana locks him into a room containing a vampire, who ironically is holding the key the teacher needed in order to escape.

Arvena Thelas is a Dunmer living in the city of Anvil. She plays a role in the first Fighters Guild quest, in which she wants to know why her pet rats she keeps in her basement are dying and for the problem to be fixed.
Arriana Valga is the Countess of Chorrol. Her husband was the hereditary Count until he passed. Countess Alessia Caro, her daughter, is married to Marius Caro, the Count of Leyawiin.

Arnora Auria is the girlfriend of Jorundr, who is incarcerated in the Bruma Jail. She was an accomplice to Jorundr's thieving around Cyrodiil. She wears an expensive amulet that looks like the Amulet of Kings except with a blue gem. She can be found in her house during the quest.
Arnskar is a Nord Barbarian, and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of Hlormaren's keep.

The Ascended Sleeper is a type of creature found in Morrowind. They appear as hunched, purple-robed humanoids with mottled blue skin. Their most obvious feature is their grotesque four-eyed faces, which have long, thin tentacles in the place of a "mouth."
Arnskar Ember-Master is a member of the Thieves Guild and a blacksmith who appears in The Ragged Flagon after completing the third of the special jobs Delvin Mallory gives to the Dragonborn.
Arob is an Orsimer guard residing in the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal, in The Reach.

Arn is the alias of an old friend of Olfrid Battle-Born who fought alongside him in the Great War. While visiting Whiterun, he was arrested for drunken behavior. Arn is wanted for murder in Solitude that may end with his execution.
Asgeir Snow-Shod is a Nord warrior residing in the city of Riften. He works at the Black-Briar Meadery, where he serves as a business partner. He is a member of Clan Snow-Shod.

Arrald Frozen-Heart is a Stormcloak captain and the commander of Hjaalmarch Stormcloak Camp and can be found there in the main tent. As an essential character, he will not die, and will remain as such even after the Civil War.
Arns Uvalas is a Dunmer Monk, and worshipper of Molag Bal residing in Bal Ur. He is typically found outside, near the shrine.
Arnsi Nerandas is a Dunmer archer and slaver who resides in the cave of Zebabi. Like the rest of the slavers, she will defend their "product" to the death, and is hostile to all outsiders.
Aroa Nethalen is a Dunmer Ordinator who resides in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. He is usually located inside the Justice Offices in the canton, and is a member of the Tribunal Temple.
Aron Andaren is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Telvanni Canton of Vivec City. He is a member of House Telvanni.

Artisa Arelas is a Dunmer pilgrim who resides at the temple of The Abbey of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. When engaged in dialogue, she may say that Clavicus Vile's Masque is in Morrowind, according to rumor.
Arvama Rathri is a Dunmer Scout residing at the Elven Nations Cornerclub in Vivec's Hlaalu Canton Plaza.
Arvamea Dalvani is a Dunmer mage and worshipper of Molag Bal who resides in Esutanamus.
Arvela Falas is a Dunmer Nightblade and House Cousin of House Hlaalu, who resides in the haunted manor at St. Olms Plaza in Vivec City.
Arven Nalyn is a Dunmer who resides in Vivec, Hlaalu Canton, within Hlaalu Ancestral Vaults.
Arvs Raram is a Dunmer Master-at-Arms and trainer residing in his house in Indarys Manor.
Arvso Tharen is a Dunmer drillmaster who resides in the village of Maar Gan.
Arvyn Llerayn is a Dunmer mage who resides in The Lizard's Head, in the Telvanni Canton. He is a retainer of House Telvanni and also a trainer.
Aronil is an Altmer battlemage who resides in the town of Seyda Neen.

Arvin Dalvilu is a Dunmer farmer residing in the village Bleaker's Way north of the Imperial City where he has his own house. He will appear during the final stages of the quest "Mephala," where he will participate in the battle against the Ulfgar clan.
Arnand Liric is an Breton member of the Imperial Legion. He resides at Buckmoth Legion Fort south of Ald'ruhn in the Ashlands region.
Aron Verethi is a Dunmer priest who replaces Avrus Adas should he die. He will appear after completion of the questline. He is also a spell merchant and offers the same spells Avrus Adas sold.

Arnsa Thendas is a Dunmer noble and a widowed who lives in her house at the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. Her former husband was a member of the Imperial Legion, and after he died, she took over his estate.
Armion is an Altmer warrior and one of the drillmasters for the goblin army, and can be found, along with Yarnar, in the Teran Hall at Old Mournhold.
Artilonwe is an Altmer soldier residing in Eagle's Strand, Khenarthi's Roost. Apart from the one line of dialogue, it is not possible to further interact with her.
Arthor the Outcast is a Bosmer beggar who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He is sitting down in the middle of town by a fountain. Arthor was robbed and has lost everything.

Arnaud Gilbeau is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He is one of many custodians who attempt to keep the city clean, and feels hostile towards the refugees in the city due to their uncleanliness.
Armel Remly is a Breton located at the Shrieking Scar, Glenumbra, and Silverhoof Vale, Rivenspire, in . He and his brother Balin are founding members of the Daggers.
Artiranwen is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Arocil is an Altmer residing at the Altmer Embassy in Elden Root, Grahtwood, in . She is located on the second floor of the main building in front of the statue of Syrabane.
Asalkin is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post, Grahtwood.
Armelle is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. She is found praying under the large tree.
Arnyeana is an Altmer guild trader found in Lake Honrich Holdings, just outside of Riften, The Rift.
Arteril is an Altmer armorer residing in the city of Haven, Grahtwood. She along with her sister Urildil, can be found in their shop, Sisters' Steel, selling her wares.
Arunen is an Altmer residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Arnaud Arbogasque is a Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He is found in the southern part of the city, either sitting down or walking around the area.
Aroth Sadri is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Mournhold.
Arver Falos is a Dunmer guild trader. He sells his wares at his kiosk in The Back Alley Market in Evermore.
Aryvena Lathoril is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares inside the Grandmaster's Palace in Kragenmoor.
Armory Sergeant Cayliss is a Bosmer traveling merchant, armsman, and a member of the Fighters Guild. She can be found in either the Baandari Trading Post, Bergama, or Windhelm.
Armory Sergeant Fretild is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is the armsman of their guildhall in Windhelm. She is Meling Snow-Bourne's sister.
Arns Tharam is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Windhelm.
Arstul is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers tasked with keeping an eye on Vulkhel Guard.
Arthur Garick is a Breton who resides in the city of Wayrest in High Rock.
Aruda is a Khajiit commoner found southeast of Geirmund's Hall. She has no unique dialogue.
Aryo Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing inside his house in Narsis.
Asadel is a Breton clothier working at a loom in the Tailors and Dyers Hall within the Saint Olms Waistworks in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Asgi Soft-Loam is a Nord found deep inside the Lost Knife Cave.
Armorer Uthik is an Orsimer warrior, and a member of the Iron Orcs clan. He may be found near Exarch's Stronghold, Craglorn.
Ash Titan is a creature that appears in City of Ash II as a boss and . Instead of serving Molag Bal like other Daedric Titans, it serves Mehrunes Dagon.

Aroz'lai is a Khajiit undercover spy of the Aldmeri Dominion, masquerading as an adventurer found in Wrothgar. He was a part of the caravan heading towards the city of Orsinium that was ambushed by the Winterborn. He can be first found at the ambushed caravan, nearby the Merchant's Gate.
Arzakh is an Orsimer clothier found in the city of Orsinium. She cannot be interacted with, but can be seen talking to Murdodosh.
Arushna is an Orsimer hunter employed by Fedar Githrano, residing in the city of Orsinium.
Arzorag is an Orsimer located in the city of Orsinium, in Skalar's Hostel. She is a Daily Job Broker.
Aseis is an Argonian laborer residing in Daggerfall. She can be found just outside the Daggerfall Millworks, listening to the announcements of Crier Martine. She has no unique dialogue.
Aryamo is an Altmer who can be found with his companion, Uluga gra-Durbug, in their camp in Greenshade.
Arvys the Elder is a Dunmer residing in the city of Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Arrianus Capius is an Imperial soldier of the Imperial Legion. He is found their garrison in the Nobles District, praying to Arkay.
Armiger Gethan is a Dunmer soldier of the Buoyant Armigers walking around the outside of the Temple Canton in Vivec City.
Armiger Tharys is a Dunmer soldier of the Buoyant Armigers residing in the Saint Delyn Waistworks in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Armiger Eithyna is a Dunmer residing in Molag Mar on Vvardenfell.

Ash Exile Savages are Dunmer brutes residing in multiple locations in Vvardenfell in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid them in combat.
Artus Farr is a Breton member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Aroarise Bereloth is a Dunmer found in the southern part of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Arrunirai is a Khajiit slave residing in Sadrith Mora who is owned by House Telvanni. She is working the same fields as Eoki under Overseer Mertisi.
Arrimoril is an Altmer residing in the garden of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene during the quest "The Queen's Decree." He has no unique dialogue.

Artura Pamarc is a Breton guild trader residing in Rimmen. She can be found at Rimmen Commerce Exchange, painting at her Guild trader stand, Masterpiece Mercantile. She opened her stand after she retired to Rimmen to meet new people.
Asazeh is a Khajiit found in the region of Northern Elsweyr, west of Riverhold. He and his friend Thaeduna are seen examining a dead ogrim.
Armiger Sydra is a dead Dunmer Buoyant Armiger whose body must be inspected during the quest "An Armiger's Duty."
Arowende is a character residing in Tel Naga, Magister's retreat in Vvardenfell.

Arrovan was a thief widely rumored about in Tamriel during the Imperial Simulacrum from 3E 389 to 3E 399. He was known to have been in possession of the Skeleton Key, a Daedric artifact of the prince Nocturnal and had stolen riches from various royal families. A "foreign scholar" was known to be tracing the history of Arrovan and was visiting various cities the thief had stolen from.

Athyn Sarethi is a Dunmer agent who may be found inside Sarethi Manor. He is known as a wise and fair Councilor of House Redoran throughout Vvardenfell. He lives in Sarethi Manor which is located in Ald'ruhn's Manor District. Athyn is also the author of "The True Noble's Code." He is the father of Varvur Sarethi.
Assamma-Idan is a Dunmer Ashlander scout who resides at his yurt in Ahemmusa Camp.
Asliel Direnni is an Altmer who harkens back to the humble beginnings of Clan Direnni. He is mentioned in the books De Rerum Dirennis and Once.

Astav Wirich is a Breton and member of the Order of the Mythic Dawn who lives in the Third Era. During the Oblivion Crisis, he is stationed in the Imperial City along with several other Dawn members. When the Blades Baurus begin investigating Mythic Dawn operations within the City, Wirich is set to tail him. He eventually managed to corner Baurus in Luther Broad's Boarding House, where Baurus is to meet with the Hero of Kvatch. Baurus tricked Wirich into following him into the inns basement, where Wirich attacks Baurus, but is ambushed from behind by the Hero. Astav falls to the two Blades. Like most Mythic Dawn members, Wirich carries a copy of the Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes with
Ashtus Chenius was an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild, who lived in the waning days of the Third Era.
Athrelor is a Bosmer commoner and refugee from Kvatch. Even with all the misery and problems, he is still open for business.
Ashu-Ahhe is a Dunmer Champion, and Ashlanders living in Erabenimsun Camp, in Morrowind.
Assaba-Bentus is a Dunmer Ashlanders Hunter who resides in Erabenimsun Camp.
Ashur-Dan is a Dunmer Ashlanders Trader who resides at his yurt in Zainab Camp.
Ashibaal is a Dunmer Ashlander Champion who resides in his yurt in Zainab Camp. He is a member of the Zainab Tribe.
Astius Hanotepelus is an Imperial Commoner who resides in Balmora, Morrowind.
Ashumanu Eraishah is a Dunmer Trader who resides in the Suran Tradehouse in Suran, where she deals in moon sugar, skooma, and radiant food and drink.
Assantus Hansar is a Dunmer barbarian living in the Ghostgate, but he only appears after Uvoo Llaren gives the quest "Cure the Outcast Outlander".
Asha-Ammu Kutebani is a Dunmer living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Asharapli Almu is a Dunmer eggminer living in Gnisis in the West Gash. She can be found inside her cave dwelling.
